brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Storage box (enclosed container with storage volume)
requirements.evidence: Hex base full cell (piece:0,0,0;full) with 6 edge caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330) forms enclosed walls, plus internal bin hex-bin-full (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full) provides storage volume. BOM: 1× hex-main, 6× hex-cap-edge, 1× hex-bin-full, ~191×169×80mm enclosure.

Full cover on top face (cover:0,0,0;full;top) – covers include magnets by default. Configurator confirmed setCoverMagnets on would be NO_CHANGE/already fitted. BOM lists 6× Neodymium disc magnet Ø5×1mm + 6× Steel BB for magnetic closure; checked via get_build/bom and verified magnets fitted.

finish.summary: Built a hexagonal storage box from a full hex base with 6 solid edge caps closing the sides and a full-depth bin inside for storage. The top is a Full cover which ships with integrated magnets (6× Ø5×1 mm neodymium magnets + 6× steel BBs in BOM) – the magnetic closure was verified as already fitted. House rules capOpenFaces/lockJoints applied, check_build clear.

events.text: Your magnetic box is up next — I'll design a lidded container that snaps shut.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A cover goes on an open top or side face of a base. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: I've carved out the basic shape with its lid — now I'm adding the magnetic latch to hold it closed.

outcomes.message: that changes nothing: the cover already has its magnets in (a cover has them unless taken out). on: false (details.toChange) would take them out.
